objections.objection: We already have an in-house team building automation on top of Astreya — why buy external?
objections.why_it_may_arise: Apollo has a dedicated digital unit (HealthCo) with engineering resources — in-house build protects roadmap control
objections.recommended_response: Our connector took an 18-month, 6-person engineering effort. We deploy in 2 weeks. Your team's time is far more valuable on clinical innovation than HIS plumbing. We can show you a detailed build-vs-buy analysis.
objections.evidence_needed: Build cost analysis comparing internal effort vs. deployment timeline

objections.objection: Patient data cannot leave our on-premise environment — cloud SaaS is a non-starter.
objections.why_it_may_arise: Healthcare data sovereignty is a hard regulatory and board-level requirement in India
objections.recommended_response: We support fully air-gapped on-premise deployment. Three current clients operate under identical compliance posture. We can share our security architecture and arrange a CISO-level call today.
objections.evidence_needed: Security architecture document and on-premise deployment case study

objections.objection: We had a failed automation pilot with a vendor 18 months ago — the board is skeptical.
objections.why_it_may_arise: Past failure creates institutional caution; board approval for another pilot will require de-risking
objections.recommended_response: We've studied those failure patterns specifically. Our pilot structure is designed to produce measurable, verifiable results in 30 days — not 6 months. Outcome-based pricing means we absorb delivery risk, not you.
objections.evidence_needed: Post-mortem comparison of past failed pilots vs. our PoC structure

objections.objection: Our budget cycle ends in Q3 and procurement takes a minimum of 4 months.
objections.why_it_may_arise: Enterprise procurement timelines in Indian healthcare routinely exceed 4 months
objections.recommended_response: Our zero-cost 30-day PoC requires no procurement approval. Once results are proven at one hospital, formal procurement runs in parallel with the extended pilot — you're not blocked.
objections.evidence_needed: Reference customer example of procurement-parallel pilot model

strategy_adjustments: Lead with build-vs-buy ROI data to defuse in-house team resistance immediately
Bring on-premise security architecture deck as a leave-behind — make data sovereignty a non-issue before it's raised
red_flags: In-house automation team may resist external vendor as a threat to their roadmap
Astreya API rate limits and undocumented endpoints may extend the 2-week integration estimate
